_comment: Capabilities reflect what each platform's OFFICIAL public API allows third-party desktop apps to do. 'manual' means the user pastes server URL + stream key from the platform's own dashboard.

platforms.name: Twitch
platforms.keyHelp: Twitch Creator Dashboard → Settings → Stream → Primary Stream Key

platforms.name: YouTube Live
platforms.keyHelp: YouTube Studio → Go Live → Stream → Stream key

platforms.name: Kick
platforms.keyHelp: Kick → Creator Dashboard → Settings → Stream URL & Key. Copy BOTH the Stream URL and the Stream Key.
platforms.limitations: Kick's public developer API is new and gated; KovaLive uses Stream URL + Key. Chat/events integration is a planned plugin once API access is approved for this app.

platforms.name: TikTok LIVE
platforms.keyHelp: Only accounts TikTok has granted stream-key access can stream from third-party software. Find Server URL + Stream Key in TikTok LIVE Center / LIVE Producer.
platforms.limitations: TikTok does not offer a public API for third-party apps to create LIVE sessions, read chat, or fetch stream keys. Eligibility is decided by TikTok.

platforms.name: Facebook Live
platforms.keyHelp: Facebook → Live Producer → Streaming software → use a persistent stream key.
platforms.limitations: The Facebook Live Video API requires a Meta app that passes App Review (publish_video, pages_manage_posts). Until KovaLive's Meta app is approved, use Live Producer stream keys.

platforms.name: Instagram Live
platforms.keyHelp: Instagram (professional accounts, where available) → Live Producer → copy Stream URL + Key. Keys are single-session.
platforms.limitations: Instagram has no public API for third-party live creation or chat.

platforms.name: X Live
platforms.keyHelp: X Media Studio → Producer → Sources → create an RTMP source.
platforms.limitations: Requires Media Studio Producer access on the X account.

platforms.name: Trovo
platforms.keyHelp: Trovo Studio → Stream settings → Stream key.

platforms.name: Custom RTMP / RTMPS
platforms.keyHelp: Any RTMP/RTMPS ingest: enter the server URL and stream key.
